about: An Eventim e-ticket by OCR alone: the REAL ML Kit blocks from Android's TicketParsingTest (the probe's own OCR lines of this ticket, 'real-eventim-2', are nearly all redacted, but agree on the order: booking block first, then the event block). The buyer name, order numbers, e-ticket code and the printed barcode number are replaced with made-up values. No line is vendor-styled caps, so the answer comes from the lines either side of the date, skipping the 'presenterer:' label. The ticket's two barcodes are Code 128, which does not make a read complete until #441, so it is never auto-added.

knownFailure.artist: No reading and no rule recovers the artist (probe 2026-09-25): the event line carries the tour name, 'Dumdumboys – XL [romertallførti]', and nothing generic says where the band's name ends. Remove this flag when a rule covers it.
